services.name: San Francisco Bay Discovery Cruise
services.desc: Join A Sightseeing Adventure On San Francisco Bay! This 90-minute sightseeing cruise is full of San Francisco icons, such as: The Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, Angel Island, San Francisco Skyline, and Pier 39.Note: This tour does not dock at Alcatraz

includes: Audio tour narrated by former inmates and guards
blurb: Guests sail from Pier 33 in San Francisco to Alcatraz Island, exploring the former prison and its history. The experience includes an audio tour narrated by former inmates and guards. Special behind-the-scenes tours and night tours are available for smaller groups.
